Name: Akkub
Summary: A porter who returned with Zerubbabel, later taught the Law when Ezra read it and kept the gates at the wall's dedication.
KeyVerses: Ezra 2:42; Ezra 2:45; Nehemiah 7:45; Nehemiah 8:7; Nehemiah 11:19; Nehemiah 12:25
RelatedEvents: Cyrus's Decree and Return from Exile; Ezra Reads the Law; Nehemiah Rebuilds the Wall
